definitions.impact: Physical coupling with a declared state, force, field, mass, momentum, stress-energy, or energy-transfer effect.
definitions.carrier: Physical field excitation, particle, wave, or propagating channel that transports causal influence.
definitions.effect: Receiver-side input-output consequence or influence extracted from a carrier or trace; not a new substance.
definitions.information: State, correlation, or payload calculated from the physical relation by a receiver or observer.
definitions.R_gen: Derived physical/history trace generated by completed impacts, transitions, and dissipation.
definitions.R_obs: Observer- or detector-dependent record after propagation, sampling, and reconstruction.
